## setup

```{r libs, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(BPCells)
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(monocle3)
library(viridis)
```

```{r params}
module = "beige_vs_white"
method = "fastmnn"
dataname = paste0("tss_", method)
load_data = T #loading data
subset_data = F

rmd_filename = "tss_fastmnn_monocle_tsne"
i_am(file.path("analysis", module, paste0(rmd_filename,".Rmd")))
odir = here("output", module, dataname)
```


```{r setup}
set.seed(8)
fig_dir = here("analysis", module, "figures", rmd_filename)
if (!dir.exists(fig_dir)) dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.path = paste0(fig_dir, "/"),
                      dev = c("png","pdf"))

if (!dir.exists(odir)) dir.create(odir, recursive = TRUE)
```


```{r themes}
theme_hp = theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        strip.background = element_blank())
theme_set(theme_hp)
pal = c("#1F78B4","#85C2EA","#B3B3B3", "#F18486","#E31A1C")
clusters = tvthemes::gravityFalls_pal()(13)
```


## Load Seurat object
```{r load_seurat}
if (subset_data){
  sbs = readRDS(here(odir, "10%_complete_analysis.rds"))
} else {
  sbs = readRDS(here(odir,"complete_analysis.rds"))
  DefaultAssay(sbs) = "RNA"
}
sbs
Idents(sbs) = "initial_clusters"
table(Idents(sbs))
```


```{r}
DimPlot(sbs, reduction="tsne") + scale_colour_manual(values=clusters) + theme_hp
```

## Convert to monocle object
```{r}
cds = SeuratWrappers::as.cell_data_set(sbs)
cds
reducedDims(cds)[["tSNE"]] = reducedDims(cds)[["TSNE"]]
```

```{r}
p = plot_cells(cds, show_trajectory_graph = F, cell_stroke=0.35, reduction_method = "tSNE", color_cells_by="initial_clusters", label_cell_groups = F) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values=clusters) + theme_hp 
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$colour = 'transparent'
p
```

Monocle runs on UMAP slot; to run with TSNE we have to overwrite the UMAP slot.  
```{r}
reducedDims(cds)[["UMAP"]] = reducedDims(cds)[["tSNE"]]
cds = cluster_cells(cds)
p = plot_cells(cds, show_trajectory_graph = F, color_cells_by = "partition", label_groups_by_cluster = F, group_label_size = 5)
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$colour = 'transparent'
p
```

```{r}
cds = learn_graph(cds, close_loop = T)
p = plot_cells(cds, color_cells_by = "initial_clusters",
           label_leaves=FALSE,
           label_branch_points=FALSE, cell_stroke=0.35, label_cell_groups = F)+ 
  scale_colour_manual(values=clusters)
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$colour = 'transparent'
p
```


## Order cells

```{r}
pick_root_node = function(cds,factor_name, start_bin){
  cell_ids = which(colData(cds)[,factor_name]==start_bin)
  closest_vertex <-  cds@principal_graph_aux[["UMAP"]]$pr_graph_cell_proj_closest_vertex
  summary(closest_vertex)
  closest_vertex <- as.matrix(closest_vertex[colnames(cds), ])
  root_pr_nodes <- igraph::V(principal_graph(cds)[["UMAP"]])$name[as.numeric(names
    (which.max(table(closest_vertex[cell_ids,]))))]
return(root_pr_nodes)
}
pick_root_node(cds, "time","day0")
pick_root_node(cds, "time","day1")
pick_root_node(cds, "time","day3")
```


```{r day0_root}
cds = order_cells(cds, root_pr_nodes = pick_root_node(cds, "time", "day0"))
p = plot_cells(cds, color_cells_by = "pseudotime", label_leaves = F, label_branch_points = F, 
                trajectory_graph_color="red") + scale_colour_viridis()
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$colour = 'transparent'
p
```


```{r adipogenesis_cluster5_root}
cds = order_cells(cds, root_pr_nodes = pick_root_node(cds, "initial_clusters", "5"))
p = plot_cells(cds, color_cells_by = "pseudotime", label_leaves = F, label_branch_points = F, 
                trajectory_graph_color="red") + scale_colour_viridis()
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$colour = 'transparent'
p
```

```{r prolif_root}
cds = order_cells(cds, root_pr_nodes = pick_root_node(cds, "initial_clusters", "8"))
p = plot_cells(cds, color_cells_by = "pseudotime", label_leaves = F, label_branch_points = F,

p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$colour = 'transparent'
```

## Save

```{r}
if (subset_data == FALSE){
  saveRDS(cds, here(odir,"monocle_complete_analysis_tsne.rds"))
  sub = subset(cds, downsample=1000)
  saveRDS(sub, here(odir ,"10%_monocle_analysis_tsne.rds"))
} else if (subset_data){ #if subset, don't save complete analysis
  saveRDS(cds, file =here(odir,"1%_monocle_subset_analysis_tsne.rds") )
}
```
